changes.issue: Unchanged successful polls left stale read-outage indicators; follower tabs could miss session changes indefinitely
changes.fix: Recover read state without hiding pending write errors; follower session revalidation every minute

changes.issue: Personal preference writes were memory-only, had no automatic retry and could overwrite unrelated remote settings
changes.fix: Scoped durable preference delta journal, bounded backoff, reload recovery and account/session generation guards

changes.issue: Mark-all-read failed above 500 IDs; rapid toggles could be written out of order; failed marks remained optimistic
changes.fix: Serialize personal mutations, batch read updates and roll back only unsaved/latest optimistic edits

changes.issue: No check of the running deployment; immutable production URL redirected to Vercel SSO
changes.fix: Credential-free public-alias smoke checks after production success events; bounded bodies and no redirect following

changes.issue: Spellcheck/deletion confirmation were not persisted; English accessible labels exposed internal field keys
changes.fix: Boolean preferences and spellcheck inheritance; labels match visible settings titles

changes.issue: Another tab's cookie switch could submit a previous account's intent under the new account

changes.fix: On-demand personal-action and thumbnail modules, preserving account checks and fallback placeholders
